topic.title: Number Guessing Game
topic.description: Two implementations of a number guessing game with limited attempts and difficulty selection. Covers while loops, conditionals, and modular function design.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using while loops for game continuation, giving high/low hints, managing an attempts counter, and separating game logic into functions.
learningNotes.challenges: Managing the attempts variable scope and resetting state between rounds.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add difficulty levels, a scoring system, and a replay loop.
